item.title: Perioperative toripalimab improves event-free survival in non-small cell lung cancer
item.description: In patients with resectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer, perioperative toripalimab plus chemotherapy increased tumor and lymph node response rates.

item.title: What is emotional regulation? A child psychologist explains
item.description: The term emotional regulation is common in mental health discussions online. A child psychologist explains what it means and how it applies to daily life.

item.title: New targeting method separates opioid pain relief from reward learning in mice
item.description: Researchers at Duke University School of Medicine are exploring ways to maintain opioid pain relief while reducing addictive potential in mice.
